plays.quote: Inspired Isles and Saint coming in. ... His toes your target yet again. TRIES TO ... FINALLY FALLS. SAINT THROWS ANOTHER rock

plays.desc_en: After the fight, LYON storms the base 4v1, destroys the first Nexus tower and keeps hitting the other, Isles lands Headbutt-Pulverize on a respawned Hizto, and LYON destroys the Nexus to win Game 1.
plays.quote: LION HAVE FOUND THEIR WAY INTO ... THE ENEMY BASE WITH A 4V1 PUSH. Dray ... Trundle alulti but the first nex turret
